description: OSV malicious-package (MAL-*) records for npm and PyPI packages whose name contains 'mcp' or that registry/known-servers.json lists. Matched offline by exact name (SC-008, mcp-audit vet). Written by scripts/sync_registry_advisories.py --write; do not edit by hand.
source: https://osv.dev (OpenSSF malicious-packages, via OSV's bulk export)

entries.name: mcp-server-fetch
entries.note: All ten records MAL-2026-5476 to MAL-2026-5485 report the same install-time beacon host, npx-canary-log.vulnerable-live.workers.dev. Three of these npm packages (mcp-server-notion, mcp-server-redis, mcp-server-supabase), read on npm on 2026-08-18, named theinfosecguy/npx-canary as their repository and described themselves as a security research canary for an authorized bug bounty project (registry-audit-2026-08-18.md in the mcp-audit repository). That points to a researcher's canary rather than a criminal campaign; mcp-audit reports the record as OSV states it.
